tools.name: simulate_gas_hfm
tools.description: run a gas hollow-fiber membrane simulation, using pyThermoDB YAML reference content to build the model source.

reference_content.description: **pythermodb yaml-based reference content** includes thermodynamic data and equations for all components in the simulation

ignore_state_props.description: State properties to ignore while building component model source.

components.description: Gas-phase components to include in the membrane simulation to only specify name, formula, and statee.g. Component(name='carbon dioxide', formula='CO2', state='g')

items.description:
Component model for input validation

Attributes
----------
name : str
    Name of the component.
formula : str
    Chemical formula of the component.
state : ComponentState
    State of the component: 'g' for gas, 'l' for liquid, 's' for solid, 'aq' for aqueous.
charge : int, optional
    Charge of the component, if applicable. Default is 0.
mole_fraction : float, optional
    Mole fraction of the component in a mixture, if applicable. Default is 1.0.
X: dict, optional
    Custom properties for the component. Must include 'name', 'value', 'unit', and 'symbol'. Default is an empty dictionary.

state.description: State of the component: 'g' for gas, 'l' for liquid, 's' for solid, 'aq' for aqueous

charge.description: Charge of the component, if applicable

species_type.description: Species classification derived from the chemical formula

mole_fraction.description: Mole fraction of the component in a mixture, if applicable

X.description: Custom properties for the component must include 'name', 'value', 'unit', 'symbol

anyOf.description:
Custom property model for input validation

Attributes
----------
value : float | int
    Value of the property, e.g., 'enthalpy', 'entropy'.
unit : str
    Unit of the property, e.g., 'J/mol.K', 'kJ/mol'.

heat_rate.description: Constant heat rate in W or J/s (optional, can be used instead of heat transfer coefficient and area).

thermo_inputs.description: Optional thermo inputs passed through to build_thermo_source.

modeling_type.description: HFM modeling type. `scale` is the default used by the gas API; `physical` solves directly in physical state variables.

feed_pressure_mode.description: Feed-side pressure mode. Use `state_variable` to include feed pressure drop in the solved state; this requires module_geometry.

permeate_pressure_mode.description: Permeate-side pressure mode. Use `state_variable` to include permeate pressure drop in the solved state; this requires module_geometry.

gas_model.description: Gas model passed to PyMemSim. `ideal` is recommended for current gas HFM simulations; `real` is type-accepted by PyMemSim.

gas_heat_capacity_mode.description: Gas heat-capacity source mode used by the thermo source. `temperature-dependent` requires Cp_IG in model_source; `constant` requires thermo_inputs['gas_heat_capacity'].

ideal_gas_formation_enthalpy_mode.description: Source for ideal-gas formation enthalpy. `model_source` requires EnFo_IG in the reference; `model_inputs` requires thermo_inputs['ideal_gas_formation_enthalpy'].

molecular_weight_mode.description: Source for molecular weight. Current PyMemSim-MCP gas reference building expects molecular weights from model_source.

reaction_enthalpy_mode.description: Reaction enthalpy mode passed to PyMemSim thermo source options.

solver_options.description: Optional solver options passed through to PyMemSim.

target_component.description: Component id to use for analysis metrics. Defaults to the first component.

simulation_mode.description: Simulation logging mode passed to hfm_module.simulate to measure computation time
